children: OMNIQ received U.S. Patent No. 12,633,155 for AI-based vehicle occupancy detection that counts occupants at highway speed.
U.S. Patent No. 12,633,155 B1 granted for HOV detection using multiband line-scan imagery and deep-learning occupant counts.
System captures two IR bands to enhance face contrast, locates windows, identifies faces, pairs counts with LPR, and blurs faces for privacy.
Company estimates a representative deployment could generate about $1.6M in annual revenue.
OMNIQ estimates a U.S. addressable market of ~$218M annually across ~136 deployable HOV/high-occupancy toll sites.
Patented technology already deployed at two U.S. sites and one international site, validating live-traffic performance.

title: OMNIQ receives U.S. patent for AI vehicle-occupancy detection, cites $1.6M per-deployment revenue
